texto: The time is asked with **o której?**. To say «a las…», the ordinal is usually located: **o siódmej**, **o ósmej**.
For intervals, expressions such as **od… do…** («from - to») are used. The days of the week are used without article: **w poniedziałek** («on Monday»).
